title: Recipe meta.json
description: skills/faion/recipes/<name>/meta.json. One meta.json per recipe directory gates its recipe.json and its card. Enforced by scripts/validate-recipes.py.

slug.description: Recipe identity in the tier manifest. Usually the directory name; -recipe is appended where the bare name would collide with a fragment or a workflow.

tier.description: Gate for the recipe. Every fragment the recipe composes must be gated at or below this tier, otherwise a user who can read the recipe cannot read its stages.

summary.description: The pipeline shape in one sentence, so a reader of recipes/INDEX.xml can compare recipes without opening a card.
